title: Nombor Tujuh Puluh Dua
subject: sitting with a father in a government hospital queue
caption: Malay devotional ballad in the veteran-diva register. Felt-muted upright piano with the pedal noise audible, a small bowed string section entering only at the chorus, fretless bass sliding between notes, no drums until a soft timpani swell near the end. Recorded in a large natural room, long real reverb tail on the voice. Mature female alto, powerful but held back, restrained Malay melisma on line ends only, chest voice. 68 BPM, F minor. Quiet pleading without self-pity. No pop beat, no synth pad, no percussion kit, no belting until the final line.
lyrics:
[Intro - felt piano]

[Verse 1]
Kerusi besi, tujuh baris ke depan
Nombor tujuh puluh dua, kami sampai pukul enam
Ayah bawa fail kuning tu macam bawa surat penting
Dia betulkan kolar sebelum nama dia dipanggil

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku yang sepatutnya tenangkan dia
Tapi dia yang pegang tangan aku

[Chorus - strings enter]
Aku tak minta banyak
Bagi dia satu lagi musim hujan
Bagi dia habiskan buku teka silang kata tu
Aku boleh tunggu. Aku dah pandai tunggu.

[Verse 2]
Doktor muda cakap laju, ayah angguk semua
Lepas tu dia tanya aku kat parking, "dia cakap apa tadi?"
Aku ulang perlahan, aku buang bahagian yang susah
Itu kali pertama aku tipu dia. Dan dia tahu.

[Chorus]
Aku tak minta banyak
Bagi dia satu lagi musim hujan
Bagi dia habiskan buku teka silang kata tu
Aku boleh tunggu. Aku tengah belajar tunggu.

[Outro - piano alone, fading]
Nombor tujuh puluh dua. Dah lepas.
